payload.blocks: Phase 5 (the send door wakes the recipient) and, after it, phases 6 and 7. Phase 4 is landed (da6d7c42e).
payload.headline: Add mailbox store tests/nudge.rs to plan 261125-2313's footprint so phase 5 can add agy to the nudge proof?

parts.cause: The plan footprint lists packages/mailbox/rust/store/tests/nudge_*.rs; the glob does not match nudge.rs, the existing owning proof of nudge capability. A lead cannot change its footprint (footprint-change-refused).

options.cost: One footprint edit; one more unit run.
options.does: Supervisor adds packages/mailbox/rust/store/tests/nudge.rs to plan.md and phase 5 footprint; phase 5 extends that assertion with agy.
options.gain: Phase 5 finishes as briefed with one owning proof for nudge capability; no duplicate test.
options.harm: None known; no other running plan lists the file as far as the lead checked.
options.label: Widen footprint by tests/nudge.rs

options.cost: Rewrite phase 5 step 3; follow-up item for agy.
options.does: Typed channel rows only for Claude Code and Codex; nudge.rs stays as is.
options.harm: agy heads keep waking only on their next tool call; brief step 3 not met as written.
options.label: Drop agy from the typed channel

parts.recommendation: Widen footprint by tests/nudge.rs: the file is the owning proof the brief tells the unit to extend; the glob simply missed it.

scope.allows: Adding packages/mailbox/rust/store/tests/nudge.rs to this plan's footprint, used only to extend the nudge-capability assertion for the typed channel.
scope.forbids: Any other change to that file or to other plans' footprints.

parts.what: Phase 5's unit wrote the typed wake (all 13 footprint files changed, typed_wake and mailbox_routes tests green) and stopped blocked: cargo test -p fgos-mailbox fails at packages/mailbox/rust/store/tests/nudge.rs:152, which pins the nudge-capable CLIs to Claude and Codex. The brief's typed channel adds agy, so that assertion must name agy too. Partial work stays in worktree forgent-worktrees/261125-2313-head-communication-agent-to-agent-p05.
